prediction_response_definition: signed full-minus-masked prediction in eV; absolute response is its absolute value

ranking_definitions.gate_path_ig: signed IG32 feature contributions summed over atoms; ranking by absolute value
ranking_definitions.modulation_magnitude: x*(g-1) summed signed; save both atom-mean and atom-sum absolute modulation, ranking by atom-sum absolute modulation
ranking_definitions.endpoint_gradient: mask=1 gradient summed signed over atoms; ranking by absolute value
ranking_definitions.random: 20 nested channel rankings; each first five exactly replays the saved random5 subset

pristine_gate_head_override.override_scope: pristine environment_gate.head only; all other build-seed weights retained

aggregation_conventions.chemical_system: sorted unique element symbols from graph atomic numbers
aggregation_conventions.system_bootstrap: whole chemical systems resampled with all case rows retained; material-weighted response mean; same resamples paired across methods
